series.title: Star Trek: Voyager
series.description: Stranded roughly 70,000 light-years from Federation space, Captain Kathryn Janeway must combine her Starfleet crew with the Maquis they were sent to capture and guide Voyager across the Delta Quadrant. The journey becomes an improvised society under pressure from unfamiliar powers, the Borg and the recurring temptation to shorten the road home at any cost.
series.collectionScope: SceneSense custom season structure follows the held scan. Title-less S04–S07 filenames are used only for exact runtime; canonical episode titles and original airdates are supplied separately. Multi-part rows remain combined exactly where the held media is combined.

series.title: Star Trek: The Next Generation
series.description: Captain Jean-Luc Picard leads the Enterprise-D on a mission of exploration that repeatedly turns first contact, diplomacy and scientific discovery into tests of judgment for a crew increasingly defined by Data's emerging humanity, Worf's divided heritage and the Federation's encounters with powers such as the Romulans, Cardassians and Borg. A custom eighth season reunites the surviving command crew decades later for one final Starfleet crisis.
series.collectionScope: SceneSense custom eight-season structure. Seasons 1–7 retain the original Enterprise-D run; Season 8 contains the ten-episode 2023 reunion continuation scanned as TNG. Presentation format is SiLVER35 through S06E01 inclusive, then SiLVER70 from S06E02 onward.
